name: Sea Level Trends at Tide Gauges

properties.station: Papeete-B, Fare Ute Point, French Polynesia
Pohnpei C, Federated States of Micronesia

metadata.description: Climate change: relative sea level trends in millimeters per year at 509 long-record tide gauges (NOAA CO-OPS Sea Level Trends, US and global stations). Red gauges are rising; blue ones sit on land that is rebounding upward, as around Alaska and Scandinavia.
